papers.title: DREEAM: Guiding Attention with Evidence for Improving Document-Level Relation Extraction
papers.limits: Selected methods/experiment scope, not complete appendices, full implementation or independent replication; no final publisher-version certification. Helper requested_version field says any; exact arxiv_id/candidate URL and observed PDF watermark pin the actual revision.
papers.findings: Entity-pair attention pooling with evidence supervision and teacher/student pseudo-targets; aggregated relation evidence, trainable encoder, extra distant relation data; optional reencoded-evidence fusion. Five dev repetitions reported as mean/standard error.
